name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: B2B Marketing Specialist | HubSpot, Email & Newsletters, LinkedIn Content, Campaign Execution
summary: Hands-on B2B marketer with 15+ years across SaaS, agency, and marketing operations, and 7 years in HubSpot. Plans and ships the work end to end: LinkedIn content and calendars, email and newsletter programs, segmentation and lead management, tracking, and the reporting that shows what to change. Grew Solenzo's audience through organic LinkedIn content into a free-audit funnel that enrolled 180+ businesses. Keeps multiple campaigns on schedule across creative, sales, and subject-matter teams, and translates technical material into content a busy expert will actually read.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Plan and publish LinkedIn content on a regular calendar, growing an audience that fed a free-audit funnel enrolling 180+ businesses.
Write and send email campaigns and newsletters in HubSpot and GoHighLevel, with segmentation, lead scoring and routing, A/B-tested subject lines, and deliverability handled end to end.
Set up tracking (GA4, Google Tag Manager, CRM attribution) before every campaign launches, and report opens, clicks, conversions, and drop-off with recommendations.
Write the Solenzo blog and guides, turning technical systems topics into clear content for non-expert readers.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Produced multi-touch email sequences, landing pages, and campaign assets, coordinating execution across creative, media, and content teams.
Ran A/B-tested LinkedIn campaigns against small, highly researched B2B audiences, and built reporting on ROI, CAC, and conversion.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Built automated communication and training sequences and sales enablement material for 15-20 reseller partners, many serving healthcare-focused businesses, retaining all but one (~94%).

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Ran client campaigns at a performance marketing agency in HubSpot, managing workflows and deliverables in ClickUp and improving reporting accuracy.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Launched 25+ client projects per month on schedule at 110% of targets, and led a team of 20 (later 8).

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
